title: tylergross97/vcf_expression_annotator pipeline parameters
description: Nextflow workflow for annotating VCF files with expression data from transcript counts.

patient_id.description: Patient ID prefix used in sample naming (must match prefix in transcript counts file)
patient_id.help_text: Example: 'PID_262622_' - Note the trailing underscore is important for matching sample IDs

samplesheet.description: Path to CSV samplesheet containing sample_id, vcf_path, and vcf_tumor_sample columns
samplesheet.help_text: When running on Seqera Platform, use absolute paths (e.g., s3://bucket/path/to/samplesheet.csv) or paths relative to the cloned repository (/.nextflow/assets/...)

transcript_counts.description: Path to merged transcript counts TSV file from nf-core/rnaseq
transcript_counts.help_text: Tab-separated file with 'tx' column and one column per sample. When running on Seqera Platform, use absolute paths or repository-relative paths.

outdir_base.description: Base output directory for all results
outdir_base.help_text: Use S3 paths when running on cloud (e.g., s3://bucket/results). Other output directories will be created as subdirectories unless explicitly specified.

outdir_split_transcript_counts.description: Output directory for split transcript count files (optional, defaults to outdir_base/split_transcript_counts)
outdir_split_transcript_counts.help_text: Leave empty to use default location based on outdir_base

outdir_vcf_expression_annotator.description: Output directory for VCF files with expression annotations (optional, defaults to outdir_base/vcf_expression_annotator)
outdir_vcf_expression_annotator.help_text: Leave empty to use default location based on outdir_base

outdir_clean_vcf.description: Output directory for cleaned VCF files (optional, defaults to outdir_base/clean_vcf)
outdir_clean_vcf.help_text: Leave empty to use default location based on outdir_base
